## Test cases

### Validate working of Edit profile

Tags: free, core_feature, ci_cd

Source: `UR_tests/03__my_account/my_account.robot`

Steps as written:

```
${global_name} =    Generate Unique Username
${user_email} =    Generate Unique Email
${password} =    Generate Random Password
Login To Wordpress
Form Builder    My Account New
Wait Until Element Is Visible    ${update_form_btn}    20s
Click Element    ${update_form_btn}
Wait Until Page Contains    Success! Form successfully saved.    20s
Wait Until Element Is Visible    ${preview_form_btn}    20s
Click Element    ${preview_form_btn}
Wait Until Keyword Succeeds    10s    2s    Switch Window    new
Fill Fields With Random Data    ${global_name}    ${user_email}    ${user_email}    testpass
Click Button    ${form_submit_button}
Verify Success Message >>    User successfully registered.
SeleniumLibrary.Close Browser
Sleep    2s
SeleniumLibrary.Open Browser    ${url}/my-account    ${browser}    options=add_argument("--incognito")
Maximize Browser Window
Login To My Account Page    ${global_name}    testpass
Wait Until Element Is Visible    //li[contains(@class,'link--edit-profile')]    20s
Click Element    //li[contains(@class,'link--edit-profile')]
Wait Until Element Is Visible    //div[@class='user-registration-MyAccount-content__header']    20s
Page Should Not Contain Element    ${double_dashboard}
Page Should Contain Element    //div[@class='user-registration-MyAccount-content__header-buttons']
Click Element    //a[normalize-space()='Edit Profile']
```

### Validate Change password when entering same current password and new password

Tags: free, core_feature

Source: `UR_tests/03__my_account/my_account.robot`

Steps as written:

```
Login To Wordpress
Add New Form    Change password
Click Button    ${update_form_btn}
Wait Until Page Contains    Success! Form successfully saved.
Click Element    ${preview_form_btn}
Switch Window    new
Genarate Random Data
MyAccount_keywords.Register A New User    ${rand_first_name}    ${r_email}    password    User successfully registered.
SeleniumLibrary.Open Browser    ${url}/my-account    ${browser}    options=add_argument("--incognito")
Maximize Browser Window
Input Text    xpath://input[@name='username']    ${rand_first_name}
Input Text    xpath://input[@name='password']    password
Click Button    //button[normalize-space()='Login']
Wait Until Page Contains Element    //nav[@class='user-registration-MyAccount-navigation']//ul    10s
Page Should Not Contain Element    ${double_dashboard}
Click Element    //li[contains(@class,'link--edit-profile')]
Wait Until Page Contains Element    //div[@class='user-registration-MyAccount-content__header']
Page Should Contain Element    //div[@class='user-registration-MyAccount-content__header-buttons']
Click Element    //a[normalize-space()='Change Password']
Wait Until Page Contains    Change Password    20s
Input Text    id:password_current    password
Input Text    id:password_1    password
Input Text    id:password_2    password
Click Element    name:save_change_password
Wait Until Page Contains    New password must not be same as old password    10s
```
